verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents one user-configurable automation: on the caregiver plan you can 'set up automated calls to check on them or remind them', which then run without the user's involvement. Call routing and roll-over rules also run unattended once set. The evidence is a single thin marketing line with no detail on scheduling, recurrence, triggers or AI-driven behavior. Automatic spam blocking is a built-in service feature, not a user-set automation, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedules versus one-off calls, configurable triggers or conditions, any AI or agentic automation, an API for programmatic automation (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
